Host controls
✓ macOS firewall on, stealth mode, auto-allow off
✓ Lume blocked inbound: VNC from this Mac only
✓ VM SSH: key only, one user, from the host only
✓ No inbound ports; every connection starts from the VM
✓ Kill switch: lume stop, revoke SA key + Slack app, restore clone
